scope: Producer literature receipt with URLs and read scope only; not signed verification, original algorithm novelty, rational-decoder execution or a proof that every auxiliary fails.
statement: Reviewed Beelen-Hoholdt-Nielsen-Wu2013 SectionIII/Theorem6 and coefficient-count inequality(2), plus Rudra2010 Sections1.2-1.4. Rational interpolation factor extraction requires strict weighted-degree below multiplicity times agreement; multiple allowed ordinates are standard list-recovery input. This motivates testing the natural elliptic curve auxiliary at the actual norm degree boundary.
